title: Vitamin B12 and Aging
subtitle: Nutrition science and practical planning related to vitamin b12 and aging.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supporting vitamin B12's role in red blood cell formation and neurologic function; moderate and emerging evidence regarding its supplementation effects on cognitive function in aging; well-documented mechanisms of absorption impairment with aging; safety data robust for supplementation in deficiency contexts.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
